en: Black-and-white image of a grand historic building on a cobblestone square. The structure has a steep tiled roof, a stepped gable richly articulated with repeated blind arches, and decorative friezes below the roofline. A turret with a conical roof marks one corner, and an arched entrance with a small canopy opens onto the street. Surrounding buildings display similar stepped-gable Renaissance architecture. A solitary person walks across the square in the foreground leading a small cart or wheelbarrow.
